method: External pre-document WebGL default-framebuffer color clear count is a per-scene rendered-frame proxy; observer RAF measures browser callback opportunity, not scene FPS. Synthetic public presentation packets pass through the real shipped Colyseus SDK/feedback/scene handler, without changing game state. CDP TaskDuration is renderer main-thread busy time, not OS CPU or GPU utilization. Audio muted; full FX selected. No game correctness assertions.
